description: A question only a person can answer: .factory/cycles/<cycle>/decisions/<id>.json, with its packet <id>.md beside it (record decision). Opened by vsdd checkpoint through decision_open; settled only by a person through settle_decision, which writes the record and nothing else. Tracked; kept permanently. Cap 4,000 bytes for the record and 12,000 for the packet. A later version may add a field: read records that carry an unknown field, never refuse them (decision D33).

id.description: The bare identifier: the kind, or <kind>.<subject>.

kind.description: One of the nine kinds of table decision-kinds.

choice.description: The choice verb as settled; empty while open.

values.description: The key=value pairs as settled; a repeated key is stored as its values joined by one space.

note.description: The free text after --; empty when the kind needs none.

digest.description: The digest of what is being decided: the specification file set for spec (topic digests), the commit for release. Empty when the kind carries none.

opened.description: ISO 8601 UTC, whole seconds, ending Z.

settled.description: The settle time; absent while open.

settled_by_session.description: The session id that settled, when settled_by is session.

reason.description: For a blocked decision: spike_limit, environment, stuck or reviewer; for spec-gap: the gap.

files.description: A spec decision: the paths the digest covers, root-relative POSIX.

accepted.description: A spec decision: the ids of the decision records it accepted.

dependencies.description: A merge decision: the names and versions it approved.
